title: Strategy Edge & Out-of-Sample Certification — pre-registered specification

hypothesis.primary: BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION generates positive risk-adjusted economic expectancy out-of-sample after realistic transaction costs and execution assumptions.
hypothesis.null: Any observed OOS performance is explained by costs, luck (trade order/sample noise), regime accident, or trivial baselines.

frozen_baseline.exit_model: stop-loss / take-profit via TradeSimulator (SL-first ambiguity rule)

D1_gatea.role: frozen fingerprint + IS statistics only (regime cutoffs, random-entry k). CONTAMINATED by definition (certification dataset). Never OOS evidence.

D2_phase7.role: secondary OOS mechanics + sample size. CONTAMINATION STATUS: used by Phase 7 breakout research — treat as lineage-contaminated, disclosed.

D3_fresh.role: PRIMARY clean OOS: fetched after strategy freeze, unseen by any development. Recorded fetch time + sha256.
D3_fresh.bars: as fetched (>=2000 required, else DATA INSUFFICIENT for primary OOS)

folds.design: contiguous non-overlapping folds, fresh engine per fold (cold start documented, no state carried), no selection (single frozen config)

costs.model: commission = CPT + PV*RATE; slippage = 2*PV*BPS/10000 (production path, post-hoc application exact: fills do not depend on costs)

sensitivity_grid.rule: pre-registered neighborhood only; report full matrix; no selection
sensitivity_grid.exclusion_reason: same-candle fills violate the no-lookahead rule

execution_variations.rule: arithmetic overlays on realized scenario-C trades; fills assumed unchanged (documented first-order approximation; V2 occupancy feedback noted)

buy_hold.method: buy $2000 BTC at OOS start close, hold to end; report gross + net of one round trip at scenario C rate

random_timing.method: 500 seeded draws; n=strategy trade count; entry bars uniform over OOS; stop=k*ATR14, TP=2k*ATR14 with k=frozen IS median(stop_dist/ATR14); $500 notional cap; scenario-C costs; same touch/SL-first exit semantics

volatility.indicator: ATR14/close at entry bar (past bars only)

trend.indicator: close vs SMA50 at entry bar (past bars only)

E1_data_integrity.pass: all datasets pass validation (chronological, unique ts, C1-E OHLC/volume rules, gaps enumerated)

E2_no_lookahead.pass: frozen pipeline, folds strictly chronological, regime cutoffs from strictly-prior data, no full-sample normalization

E3_independent_oos.pass: D3 exists with >=2000 bars AND pooled OOS exists; contamination of D1/D2 disclosed

E4_walkforward.pass: folds execute with no leakage (methodological); economics judged under E5/E6

E6_sample_adequacy.pass: pooled OOS trades >= 30 for EDGE claims; E6 gates GREEN/YELLOW-EDGE only, never RED-via-costs

E7_regime.pass: no single regime holds >70% of pooled net AND every reported cell has >=3 trades, else INSUFFICIENT/FAIL

E8_execution.pass: net(C + variation) > 0 for V1, V2, V3 separately

E9_montecarlo.pass: P(net<0) < 5% AND P(DD > observed) < 10% at scenario C

E10_baselines.pass: strategy net(C) > random-timing median AND > 0 (B&H reported for context, non-gating)

E11_reproducibility.pass: two processes agree on deterministic parts; seeded MC reproduces

verdict_rules.YELLOW: E6 INSUFFICIENT, or mixed/weak evidence short of RED triggers
verdict_rules.RED: E5 FAIL (costs destroy edge) OR walk-forward economics fail OR isolated-trade dependence OR execution variations destroy economics OR baseline failure

research_boundary.area: research/phase11e/ (new code) + scripts-style runners importing production read-only
research_boundary.config_overrides: mock.patch of risk_settings inside research runs only, restored via finally (same pattern as scripts/cost_sensitivity_11b.py)
